problem_markdown: Start from any plane point $P_0$. Repeatedly rotate $120^\circ$ clockwise about $A_1,A_2,A_3,A_1,\ldots$ to obtain $P_1,P_2,\ldots$. If $P_{1986}=P_0$, prove triangle $A_1A_2A_3$ is equilateral.
solutions_markdown:
Use complex coordinates and put $\omega=e^{-2\pi i/3}$. Rotation about $a$ sends $z$ to $\omega z+(1-\omega)a$. Composing the three rotations sends
$$z\longmapsto z+t,\qquad t=(1-\omega)(\omega^2a_1+\omega a_2+a_3),$$
because $\omega^3=1$. After 1986 steps there have been 662 identical blocks, so $P_{1986}=P_0$ forces $662t=0$, hence $t=0$.

Using $1+\omega+\omega^2=0$, this becomes
$$a_3-a_1=-\omega(a_2-a_1).$$
The multiplier $-\omega$ has modulus one and angle $60^\circ$. Thus $A_1A_3=A_1A_2$ and their included angle is $60^\circ$, so all three sides are equal.
